scene: In an empty pastel confectionery kitchen at bright morning, decorating berry-shaped jelly desserts on a counter with a small spoon in one hand and the other open hand beside the tray; both complete hands and forearms within waist-up crop. Soft window light, no lettering.
outfit: Opaque lilac square-neck sleeveless cropped blouse and high-waisted cream shorts with a small plum waist apron, tiny round violet earrings. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff, fully covered chest and pelvis; no armor.
custom: 1024x1536 vertical. Preserve the approved adult face and haircut. Both complete hands visibly connect to their respective forearms, with one thumb and four separate natural fingers each. No weapons, text, logos or extra figures.
